topPick.thesis: Marathon Petroleum (MPC) is trading at 7.4x P/E, a 49% discount to its sector average of 14.4x; RSI at 20 flags significantly oversold conditions with mean-reversion potential. Three-month price momentum of +11.5% reflects strong institutional accumulation, with EPS growing +490% year-on-year, underpinned by a bearish MACD signal suggesting near-term caution is warranted. Composite score of 82/100 places MPC in the top 1% of S&P 500 constituents across all four analytical strategies, outperforming its sector by +9.2% over the past quarter.
